message: No detected input validation: The /summarize-video endpoint accepts any UploadFile without validating file type, size, or content; Pydantic models are defined for response schemas but are not applied to the incoming upload.

No detected untrusted source handling: Files are downloaded from and uploaded to Google Drive using hardcoded folder IDs with no checksum verification, content integrity checks, or signed-URL validation on retrieved data.

No detected label flipping detection: The code handles video uploading and summarization but contains no label distribution checks, label validation against an expected set, or any label-noise detection tooling.
No detected data poisoning defenses: Uploaded video files are saved and processed directly without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the data.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights from local file paths (e.g., weights_model/tvsum_random_non_overlap_0.6271.tar.pth) and pickle files without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before use.
No detected label distribution validation: The code loads pre-trained model weights and runs inference; there is no training loop or label distribution validation present.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor detection, trigger analysis, or gradient anomaly detection is implemented anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are used in the code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any stress-test logic are present in the code; the pipeline simply runs video summarization inference.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evaluation metric computation, held-out test set isolation, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics visible in this code slice.

No detected output bounds checks: There are no visible checks on the model's output values (e.g., NaN guards, probability bounds, or sanity checks on summary/segment results) before they are packaged and returned to the caller.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a video summarization model (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
